name: Po Nagar Towers
kicker: Cham towers on the hill north of the beach
summary: The Cham towers stand about 2 km north of the centre. The provincial digital guide prints 06:00–17:30 and no ticket. The provincial tourism department prints 08:00–18:00 and 22,000 VND a person. The hill is over 20 m in the digital guide and about 10–12 m in the tourism department. Read both before you go up.
fee: 22,000 VND from the provincial tourism department
getThere: About 2 km north of the centre. Minutes were not printed.
heroCaption: The main brick tower and the pyramid tower in the courtyard

notice.title: The two clocks do not match
notice.body: The provincial digital guide opens at 06:00 and closes at 17:30, and prints no ticket. The provincial tourism department opens at 08:00, closes at 18:00, and prints 22,000 VND. From 6 to 11 May 2026 Khánh Hòa police print free entry.

body: Po Nagar is the Cham complex on đồi Cù Lao, in Vĩnh Phước. The provincial digital guide gives the address as Tháp Bà Ponagar, Hai Tháng Tư. The provincial tourism department gives 61 Đường 2/4. Both say the site is about 2 km north of the centre. The digital guide says the hill is over 20 m. The tourism department says about 10–12 m. The digital guide gives the site area as 17,683.6 m² and runs the complex from the 8th to the 13th centuries.

The provincial digital guide and the provincial tourism department both print the tower heights. The main tower is about 23 m. The south tower is about 18 m. The northwest tower is about 9 m. The southeast tower is about 7 m in the digital guide and 7.1 m in the tourism department. The tourism department dates the main tower to 813–817, repaired in the 11th century, the northwest tower to 817 and repaired in the 13th century, and the southeast tower to the 11th–12th centuries. Both date the south tower to the 13th century.

The heritage department still calls the site a national historical-cultural relic. Decision 152/QĐ-TTg of 17 January 2025, reported by the heritage department and echoed by the provincial police, ranks Tháp Bà Pô Nagar a special national relic. The heritage department and the provincial tourism department put the annual festival at lunar 20–23 of month 3. Khánh Hòa police print 6–11 May 2026, lunar 19–25, and free entry for those days. The heritage department times the traditional rite at 4:00–6:00 on the 23rd. The tourism department times it at 6:00–8:00.

gettingThere: The provincial digital guide and the provincial tourism department both put the towers about 2 km north of the centre. The street line differs: Hai Tháng Tư in the digital guide, 61 Đường 2/4 in the tourism department. Minutes from Trần Phú or the station were not printed.
